honesty.access: anonymous only; no credential is entered, stored, or synthesized, so no premium payload can enter these artifacts
honesty.authority: this harness measures and screenshots; it scores, ranks, and judges nothing
honesty.capture_method: NOT a live `/stocks/MSFT.html` site route capture (this PR is stacked on unmerged #6920 and has never been rendered by the real build pipeline into `site/`). Instead: the committed golden MSFT fixture (`tests/fixtures/security_state/golden_msft_expected_output.json`) was passed through the real `scripts.build_ticker_pages.build_security_state()` projection and rendered through the real `templates/ticker.html.j2` (Jinja, `ChainableUndefined` for the page vars this isolated capture does not supply). The rendered page's `#security-state` section — Overview, the five remaining axis cards, Evidence, and Owner & model receipts — was extracted with the template's own inline `<style>` block and `templates/theme.css` into a standalone harness page with no other page chrome (nav, chart, other panels). These 8 captures are the evidence that Overview and Owner & model receipts read correctly in BOTH themes, not an assertion that they do. Recapture at head `4891dba55ae4`: count-free subhead ('The panels below.' / '以下面板。'), state sentence printed once on the surface, Overview Receipts control, bilingual R1–R9 house copy.
honesty.gaps: states that were not captured are recorded with a reason; nothing is inferred for them
honesty.light_theme_judgment: Judged as a design, not a token swap: light renders a white/near-white cool canvas (`--bg`/`--panel2` light tokens already defined in `templates/theme.css`), hairline `1px` dividers on the R1..R9 receipt rows (`.ss-chk` border `--hair`), and dark ink text — a materially different surface from dark's luminance-depth translucent panel (`color-mix` of `--panel2` with transparent) and restrained rail glow. Chip elevation in light mixes the state hue with `#fff` rather than with `transparent` (the existing `[data-theme=light] .ss-cell` / `.ss-chip` rules). These 8 captures are the evidence that both new panels read correctly as a research-workspace surface in light and a command-center surface in dark.
